onboarding.title: Private messaging
onboarding.subtitle: End-to-end encrypted. No phone number. Minimal, temporary metadata.

conversationList.selfConversationError: You can't start a conversation with yourself.
conversationList.untrustedIdentityError: {{peerId}}'s security key changed since last time (they probably reinstalled the app). Confirm the other person's identity before trying again.
conversationList.blockedChannelError: This conversation can't be started: one of you has blocked the other.
conversationList.emptyState: No conversations yet. Seixo has no usernames or phone numbers: to talk, you swap your IDs or scan each other's QR code. Messages here are end-to-end encrypted.
conversationList.demoBody: Try Seixo with a demo contact: it replies by itself with sample messages, so you can see the filter, photos, reporting and blocking.
conversationList.demoConfirmBody: This is an automatic Seixo account. Unlike a person, what you write to it is read by our server so it can reply. Don't send it anything private.
conversationList.renameHint: Only you see this name: it stays on this phone and is never sent to the server.
conversationList.deleteConversationBody: You leave the conversation and delete its history from this phone. The other person can no longer message you here. This is not the same as blocking: either of you can start a new conversation later.
conversationList.deleteConversationFailed: Could not leave the conversation. Please try again.
conversationList.muteFailed: Could not change notifications for this conversation. Try again.
conversationList.backupPromptBody: If you lose this phone, your account and your contacts go with it: there is no way to restore them, not even by us. The backup takes a minute.

conversation.emptyState: No messages in this conversation yet.
conversation.blockConfirmMessage: You won't be able to exchange messages with {{peerId}} anymore. You can unblock them later in Settings > Blocked.
conversation.securityWarningDecrypt: {{peerId}}'s security key changed since your last conversation. This message wasn't decrypted: confirm with the other person before continuing.
conversation.securityWarningSend: {{peerId}}'s security key changed since your last conversation. The message wasn't sent: confirm with the other person before continuing.
conversation.deleteMessageBody: The message is deleted from the server, from this phone and from the other person's: straight away, or the next time they open the app. But they may already have seen it, and nothing prevents a screenshot.
conversation.deleteFailed: Could not delete the message from the server. It was removed from this phone.
conversation.sendFailed: Could not send. Check your connection and try again: your text is still here.
conversation.blockFailed: Couldn't block. Check your connection and try again.
conversation.leaveGroupBody: You stop receiving messages from this group and its history is deleted from this phone. The group carries on for everyone else: only its owner can add you back.
conversation.leaveGroupFailed: Could not leave the group. Check your connection and try again.
conversation.editingHint: The other person will see it was edited.
conversation.editFailed: The edit didn't reach the other person. Try again.
conversation.reactionFailed: The reaction didn't reach the other person.
conversation.recordingInterrupted: The phone interrupted the recording (a call, or the screen locking) and it was not sent. You can record again.
conversation.microphoneDenied: Seixo needs microphone access to record.
conversation.cancelRecordingLabel: Cancel the recording without sending it
conversation.blockMemberBody: You stop receiving this person's messages: in this group and in any conversation. They stay in the group and are not told. Messages you already received stay here. You can unblock in Settings > Blocked.
conversation.blockMemberDone: Member blocked. Their messages will no longer appear.
conversation.blockMemberFailed: Could not block. Check your connection and try again.
conversation.groupOwnerNote: Only whoever created the group can add or remove people.
conversation.groupNoHistoryNote: Anyone joining now cannot see earlier messages: they were encrypted with keys that person does not have.
conversation.emptyGroupNotice: This group has nobody in it yet. Tap Members to add people: messages can only be sent after that.
conversation.deleteGroupBody: The group and its messages disappear from the server for everyone. Messages each person already received stay on their phone until their timer removes them: this cannot reach those.
conversation.groupNameFailed: The name didn't reach the other members.
conversation.oneOffTtlHint: Applies to the next message only. The conversation keeps its own timer.
conversation.locationConfirmBody: Your position right now, accurate to about {{meters}} m, goes encrypted to this conversation only. Seixo and the server cannot see it. It is sent once: it does not follow where you go.
conversation.locationConfirmBodyNoAccuracy: Your position right now goes encrypted to this conversation only. Seixo and the server cannot see it. It is sent once: it does not follow where you go.
conversation.locationDenied: Without access to your location, there is nothing to send.
conversation.locationUnavailable: Could not find where you are. Check that Location Services are on and try again.
conversation.locationFallback: Location: {{coordinates}} (update Seixo to open it in a map)
conversation.filePrepareFailed: Could not prepare the file. Nothing was sent.
conversation.filePickFailed: Could not open the file picker.
conversation.fileTooLargeBody: "{{name}}" is over 10 MB, the most Seixo sends. Nothing was sent.
conversation.fileWarningBody: "{{name}}" travels encrypted, but Seixo cannot clean it the way it cleans photos. A PDF, a Word or an Excel file can carry hidden your name, your computer's name, dates, earlier versions, comments or photos with their location. It stays on the server for 24 hours at most, and whoever receives it can save it.
conversation.imagePickFailed: Could not open the camera or the library.
conversation.imagePrepareFailed: Could not prepare the image. Nothing was sent.
conversation.imageMetadataRefused: This image still carried photo data (such as its location) after being cleaned, so it was not sent.
conversation.cameraDenied: Without camera access, a photo cannot be taken.
conversation.sharedImageHint: Sent without its location or camera details.
conversation.screenshotFallback: 📸 I took a screenshot of this conversation.
conversation.reportMessageBody: The text of this message and the ID of whoever sent it are sent to the Seixo team. It is the only way we can ever see a message: you choose to show it to us. We review every report within 24 hours and expel anyone who breaks the terms.
conversation.reportPersonBody: This person's ID is sent to the Seixo team, who review the report within 24 hours. To report a specific message, press and hold it.
conversation.reportGroupHint: To report someone in a group, press and hold the message you want to report and choose "Report". You can also block a member under "Members".
conversation.reportSentBody: Thank you. We will review it within 24 hours. If three different people report the same account, it is suspended immediately.
conversation.reportFailed: Could not send the report. Please try again.
conversation.reportLimit: You have sent many reports today. Try tomorrow, or write to us at seixo.app@proton.me.
conversation.hiddenMessage: Message hidden because it contains offensive language. Tap to view.
conversation.accountRestricted: Your account was suspended after reports and cannot send messages. If you think this is a mistake, write to us at seixo.app@proton.me.
conversation.reportPhotoBody: This photo and the ID of whoever sent it are sent to the Seixo team. It is the only way we can ever see it: you choose to show it to us. We review every report within 24 hours and expel anyone who breaks the terms.
conversation.reportFileBody: The name of this file and the ID of whoever sent it are sent to the Seixo team. The file itself is not sent. We review every report within 24 hours and expel anyone who breaks the terms.
conversation.reportLocationBody: This message is reported without the location: only the ID of whoever sent it goes. We review every report within 24 hours and expel anyone who breaks the terms.
conversation.reportVoiceBody: This voice message and the ID of whoever sent it are sent to the Seixo team. It is the only way we can ever hear it: you choose to show it to us. We review every report within 24 hours and expel anyone who breaks the terms.

settings.deleteConfirmMessage: This deletes your identity and all associated data on the server (keys, prekeys, started conversations, blocks) and on this device. This can't be undone.

sounds.hint: The sound plays when a notification arrives. The sounds ship inside the app: the server never sends audio, only the name of the one you chose. If the phone is on silent, iOS plays none.
sounds.saveFailed: Your choice is saved on this phone, but the server could not be told. It will be sent next time you open the app.

settings.appLockUnavailable: This device has no Face ID, Touch ID or passcode set, so there is nothing for Seixo to check against.
settings.backupHint: Saves your identity to an encrypted file, so you can get back into the same account on another phone. Messages are not included.
settings.showPreviewsHint: In the conversation list, under each name. Turn it off if you don't want someone looking at your screen to see it.
settings.serverFootprintHint: See, right now, everything that exists about you on the server.
settings.appLockRowHint: Face ID, or a Seixo-only code with a panic code.
settings.hideFromRecordingHint: When on, a screen recording, or mirroring to another screen, shows Seixo as black. Screenshots are not affected: in a conversation, everyone is told about them.
settings.invitesRowHint: See, share again or cancel the invites you made.

screenshotWarning.title: Screenshot
screenshotWarning.message: You took a screenshot. Remember conversations here are private: avoid sharing them.

scanQr.hint: Point the camera at the other person's QR code.

notifications.title: Seixo
notifications.groupBody: You were added to a group.

safetyNumber.title: Safety number
safetyNumber.explanation: Compare this code with the other person: in person, by call, or any way other than this app. If it matches on both phones, nobody is in the middle reading you.
safetyNumber.resetWarning: This person's security key changed. That happens when they reinstall the app, but it is also what you would see if someone were impersonating them. Only continue if you have confirmed the code above with them by other means.

backup.intro: The backup holds who you are: your ID and your key. On a new phone your contacts keep talking to you without having to verify you again. Messages are not included: they still disappear on the timer you chose.
backup.credentialsError: The account did not accept its recovery credentials, so this backup would not let you back in. Nothing was saved.
backup.phraseWarning: Without these words the file cannot be opened, and there is no way to recover them. Do not keep them in the same place as the file.
backup.phraseCopiedMessage: The words are on the clipboard. Paste them somewhere safe, then clear the clipboard.
backup.fileHint: You choose where it goes: Files, iCloud, AirDrop to your computer. The file is useless to anyone without the 12 words.
backup.footnote: None of this is kept on our server. We hold no copies and cannot recover yours if you lose it.
backup.expiryWarning: The account still deletes itself after 6 months without being opened, and the backup stops working with it. Opening the app now and then is enough to prevent that.

restore.intro: Getting back into the same account takes both parts: the file and the 12 words.
restore.phrasePlaceholder: the twelve words, separated by spaces
restore.phraseInvalid: These words are not a valid phrase. Check whether one is misspelled.
restore.footnote: Old messages do not come back: they were never in the backup. Conversations start again, with the same ID and the same safety number.
restore.accountGone: The words are right and the file opened, but this account no longer exists. It was most likely deleted after 6 months without use. You can create a new identity, but the old ID does not come back.

terms.title: Before you start
terms.intro: Seixo is for private conversations between people who know each other. To use it, you agree to these rules:
terms.rule1: Zero tolerance for objectionable or offensive content and for abusive users, including illegal content, child sexual abuse, harassment, threats, hate speech, spam and fraud.
terms.rule2: Nobody can read your messages, not even us. That is why you can block and report any person or message, and we review every report within 24 hours.
terms.rule3: Anyone who breaks these rules is expelled: the account can no longer send messages and leaves every conversation.
terms.rule4: You are responsible for what you send. Disappearing messages do not stop someone taking a screenshot.
terms.rule5: You must be at least 18 years old.

permissions.microphoneBlockedBody: You turned off microphone access. To record voice messages, turn it on in iPhone Settings, under Seixo.
permissions.cameraBlockedBody: You declined camera access. To take photos, turn it on in the phone’s Settings. Choosing from the library still works without it.
permissions.locationBlockedBody: You declined location access. To send it, turn it on in the phone's Settings, under Seixo. Seixo only reads it when you choose to send it.

share.intro: Choose a conversation. The content goes into the text box and is only sent when you press send.
share.empty: You have no conversations yet. Start one and share again.
share.introImage: Choose the conversation. The photo is ready to send and only leaves when you press send.

serverFootprint.intro: This is everything that exists about you in the database, read just now. None of it is stored on the phone: close this and come back, and it is asked for again.
serverFootprint.lastUseHint: The day only. The time is never stored.
serverFootprint.keysHint: Signed + one-time, so others can start a conversation with you.
serverFootprint.displayNameHint: Published by you and unreadable to the server.
serverFootprint.noConversations: The server holds no conversations of yours.
serverFootprint.absentList: The content of messages · what photos show · what files contain, and their names · who sent each message or photo in a one-to-one conversation (in the database) · the names you gave your contacts · the names of groups. The exception: a report keeps the reported message (text, photo or audio) and who sent it, for 90 days.
serverFootprint.hostingNote: This is the database. Before a request reaches it, the hosting provider's entry layer records it with your IP, the approximate city and postal code, your internet provider, what was requested (never the content) and, in most cases, your account id. The hosting provider keeps it under its own rules, which we do not control, and we cannot delete it. It is explained in the privacy policy.
serverFootprint.hostNowSection: What the host sees right now
serverFootprint.hostAsk: See what the host sees right now
serverFootprint.hostAskHint: The IP address this request reaches the server with.
serverFootprint.hostNowFooter: This is the address that goes into the hosting logs with every request the app makes. Those logs also record the country, city, postal code and internet provider that match it, but that stays in the entry layer and never reaches our code, so we cannot show it here. Seixo stores none of this: the answer only appears on this screen. With a VPN, you see the VPN's address.
serverFootprint.imagesFooter: Each one is deleted with its message, at most 24 hours after it was sent. The server sees its rounded size, never the picture or the file, nor the file's name or type.
serverFootprint.imagesDownloadedHint: The storage service records when each attachment is downloaded. We cannot prevent it.

messageServerView.intro: This message as it is on the server, read just now. It is everything that exists of it there, plus the hosting logs, at the end, which the app cannot read but which exist.
messageServerView.sizeHint: Exact. Text is not rounded, so the size gives an idea of how long the message is. Voice messages are rounded.
messageServerView.sizeGroupHint: Exact. In a group it includes one encrypted copy per member, so it grows with the group.
messageServerView.expiresAtHint: When the server deletes it, even if nobody has read it.
messageServerView.senderDirectHint: In a one-to-one conversation, the message does not say who sent it.
messageServerView.senderGroupHint_one: In a group it is visible: the server sees who sent it and that there is a copy for {{count}} member.
messageServerView.senderGroupHint_other: In a group it is visible: the server sees who sent it and that there are copies for {{count}} members.
messageServerView.fileFooter: Encrypted with a key that exists only inside the message. The server cannot open it.
messageServerView.fileSizeHint: Rounded up, so as not to reveal the photo's real size.
messageServerView.documentSizeHint: Rounded up, so as not to reveal the file's real size. The file's name and type are not on the server: only inside the encrypted message.
messageServerView.fileDownloadedHint: Written by the storage service. It says, roughly, when it was received.
messageServerView.gone: The server no longer has this message
messageServerView.goneFooter: It was deleted from the server: by its timer, because someone deleted the message, or because it is a voice message or photo, which the server keeps for 24 hours at most. The copy you see exists only on the phones.
messageServerView.hostingMine: Your send was logged with your account, your IP and your approximate location.
messageServerView.hostingTheirs: The send was logged with the account of whoever sent it. When you received it, your request was logged the same way, with your account.
messageServerView.hostingKept: Kept by the hosting provider under its own rules. We do not control it and cannot delete it.

lockSettings.methodFooter: Messages keep arriving while the app is locked.
lockSettings.deviceHint: The iPhone checks; Seixo only learns whether it passed.
lockSettings.codeHint: Six digits, checked by the app itself. Allows a panic code. No Face ID: with it, anyone could just hold the phone up to your face.
lockSettings.panicHint: A second code that erases everything on this phone and opens the app as new.
lockSettings.panicFooter: If you forget your Seixo code, the only way back in is to delete the app and install it again, and you lose the conversations on this phone.
lockSettings.panicExplainBody:
It is a second code. If someone forces you to open Seixo, you type this one instead of the real one.

The app opens as if it had just been installed, and that is what it becomes: everything on this phone is erased at that moment, for good. Conversations, photos, keys and settings.

Your account stays on the server. If you have a backup (the 12 words), you can restore it later and talk to the same contacts again. Old messages do not come back.

There is no undo. Choose a code you will not mix up with the real one.
lockSettings.panicEnterBody: It must be different from the code that opens the app.
lockSettings.panicSameAsUnlock: That is the code that opens the app. Choose another.
lockSettings.codeEnterBody: Six digits. You will be asked for it every time you come back to the app.
lockSettings.mismatch: The codes do not match. Start again.
lockSettings.saveFailed: Could not save. The code that opens the app and the panic code must be different.
lockSettings.leaveCodeBody: The panic code only exists with the Seixo code. If you switch, it is gone.

peerId.notAnIdBodyNoQr: Seixo has no usernames: ask the person for their ID (the My ID button on their conversation list) and paste it here.

invite.listIntro: Each invite works once and expires after 7 days. We don't know who you sent it to or who used it: only whether it was used.
invite.listEmpty: You haven't made any invites yet.
invite.cancelBody: The link stops working for whoever has it.

error.blocked: You can't start this conversation: one of you has blocked the other.

error.tooMany: You already have 20 unused invites. Cancel one in "Your invites" before making another.
